requirements.text: Personalised timetable management with features like color-coding, hiding canceled sessions, and adding personal study times.
Automated grade notifications sent immediately via email, SMS, or in-app notifications.
A structured module feedback system for students to give feedback on course content, delivery, and resources while maintaining anonymity.
The enhancements must integrate smoothly with the existing login process.
The current database structure cannot be altered.
Feedback must only be available to coordinators after grades are submitted.
